d:
Gold Rush follows Parker Schnabel's journey from a young miner learning the ropes to a determined leader taking charge of his own mining operation. Through tough decisions, costly mistakes, ambitious targets and hard-earned victories, Parker grows with every season. But what did it take for him to become one of the most recognised names in the Klondike gold rush?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 2, 7, 11 and 15; and Season 6, Episodes 2, 5, 6, 10 and 19, on Discovery Channel India.
